source.title: DONKI: Space Weather Database Of Notifications, Knowledge, Information
source.access: NASA API portal https://api.nasa.gov (DONKI/SEP, DONKI/CME; personal API key)

flares.reason: api.nasa.gov DONKI/FLR returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-13; SEP and CME endpoints worked

caveat: Events are catalogued from near-Earth and heliospheric spacecraft; they are not a measured dose or flux at the landing site. The Moon spends part of each month inside Earth's magnetotail.
